compute.basis: The target is a headline result from RL fine-tuning Qwen2.5-VL-7B with GRPO on 22K multi-image + 36K single-image examples using 8×H100 GPUs; there is no CPU-only or laptop-scale path described.

blockers: Requires RL training a 7B vision-language model; paper used 8×H100 GPUs.
GPT-4o API is used for data rephrasing and semantic-variation preprocessing.
No confirmed released PeRL checkpoint/config for direct evaluation of the exact headline score.
16 GB laptop RAM is insufficient for 7B VLM training and likely for practical full evaluation.
title: PeRL: Permutation-Enhanced Reinforcement Learning for Interleaved Vision-Language Reasoning
